limits: Standalone archived primitive executables, not the current production DSOs or all historical split32 programs.
Seven small cases per parameter: raw permutation, SHAKE, uniform, eta at 17/65 requests, ExpandMask and SampleInBall; three comparison backends are retained.
No source edits, no compilation and no performance claim. A pass only covers the selected inputs and binary hashes.
150-second execution budget across three processes; each owned instrumented child is limited to 45 seconds or remaining budget. Export/SSH transfer are additional.
Only the child process group created by this runner may be stopped at timeout; no other GPU process is stopped.
